admitted.nl: Copy the grid, then set cell (row 3, column 5) to 1 (zero-based).
Set (3,5) to 1 only when that cell is zero; otherwise preserve the grid.

Copy the grid, set (3,5) to 1, and additionally set (0,0) to 2 on any grid larger than 7x7.

Copy the grid and set (3,5) to 1, but replace every 9 with 0 on other inputs.
Copy the grid and set the cell symmetric to (3,5) across the vertical axis to 1 as well, except on 7x7 grids.
Copy the grid and set (3,5) to 1 only when the top-left cell is zero; otherwise invert all colors 1 and 2.

rejected.nl: Copy the grid and add a 1 at (3,5), but on non-7x7 grids return the input unchanged.
